title: Research: workload identity for agents outside Entra (SPIFFE and SPIRE, Kubernetes service account tokens)
goal: Answer with the kb tools first and official sources for the rest, writing facts through /kb-research with a new topic auth/spiffe-workload-identity where no article fits: What are a SPIFFE ID and an SVID? How does SPIRE attest a workload before issuing an SVID? How are X.509 and JWT SVIDs rotated and verified between services? How do projected Kubernetes service account tokens give a pod a short-lived, audience-bound identity?
